# College of Echoes

The Rift has swallowed worlds. Their music remains. Bards of the College of Echoes learn to hear what's left — and perform it. Their songs open momentary tears in reality, flooding the present with the emotions of civilizations that died centuries ago.

## Echo Channeling

*3rd-level College of Echoes feature*

You can spend your Bardic Inspiration dice to channel echoes of lost worlds. As a bonus action, you spend one Inspiration die to produce one of the following effects. You learn two echoes at this level: Lament and Anthem. You learn additional echoes at higher levels.

**Lament.** Enemies within 30 feet who can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw against your spell save DC or have disadvantage on their next attack roll. You can affect a number of enemies based on the die spent: d6 affects 1, d8 affects 2, d10 affects 3, d12 affects 4.

**Anthem.** Allies within 30 feet who can hear you gain temporary hit points equal to the Inspiration die roll + your Charisma modifier. The courage of a people who faced the Rift and stood.

## Echoes Known

*6th-level College of Echoes feature*

Your repertoire expands. You learn two additional echoes:

**Grief.** As an action, choose one creature within 60 feet. It must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is incapacitated until the end of its next turn — crushed by the sorrow of a world that lost everything. On a success, nothing happens. Costs one Inspiration die.

**Wonder.** As a bonus action, choose one ally within 60 feet. They gain advantage on their next ability check or saving throw within the next minute, briefly touched by the awe of a world that never knew the Rift. Costs one Inspiration die.

*10th-level College of Echoes feature*

You learn your final two echoes:

**Terror.** As an action, enemies within 15 feet who can hear you must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of you until the end of your next turn. The fear of a dying civilization given voice. Costs one Inspiration die.

**Defiance.** As a reaction when an ally within 30 feet takes damage, you can spend one Inspiration die. That ally gains resistance to that instance of damage, armored by the last stand of a people who refused to break.

## Worldfall

*14th-level College of Echoes feature*

Once per long rest, you can channel the echo of an entire world's final moment. As an action, every echo you know fires simultaneously in a 60-foot radius centered on you. Enemies in the radius make a single Wisdom saving throw against all hostile effects. Allies receive all beneficial effects. The die size used is the largest you have remaining.

Worldfall requires you to have at least one Bardic Inspiration die remaining. It consumes all of them. For 1 minute afterward, you cannot regain Inspiration dice and cannot use any echo. You've emptied yourself — the silence afterward is the silence of a world that no longer sings.
